_doc: EVO lever registry (Owner y 2026-11-12, EVO-PLAN.md). One entry per method lever. family = mechanism family (a research transition must change it). kind = exploit | research | repair (repair levers only repair an instrument). requires = product-relative files that must exist. status open|retired; retired levers name the negative row and its reopen condition. The autopilot adds history-based retirements in state.json, never here.

KSR.what: fwidth operator on frozen held-out CNM cohorts, then certification through the unchanged certify.decide (S28K certified 15; S30K 16 exact all refused TARGET_UNPROVEN).

The 16 S30K held-out exacts were refused TARGET_UNPROVEN (ids absent from the ksr-v5r-s25stage target oracle) and A2_POPULATION_EMPTY (partner pool built from the wrong set; S32K H-A2 SUPPORTED, control 15/15). Extend target-oracle coverage for exactly these ids from ORIGINAL DOL bytes with an independent reader (the S26C C1 method: own DOL and ELF readers, positive and shift negative controls), build the A2 partner pool from the main-capsule hash and size, then certify through the UNCHANGED certify.decide into a separate receipts file. If the profile cannot read the extended oracle without a change, use a NEW additive profile that meets all six S26C conditions. Rival hypotheses: (a) the 16 certify once covered; (b) they fail the oracle or a control (a target mismatch the refusal was hiding).

45 BINARY_EXACT from the fixed S26C '?' fallback (t1 8057ec26): exclude ids certified in any receipts file, then certify through the unchanged certify.decide of profile ksr-v5r-s25stage with the S26D controls (pre/post, A2 negatives from a pool that contains the claims, historical receipts byte-identical) into a separate receipts file. Rival hypotheses: (a) most certify; (b) the fallback source changes bytes of partners (A2 violations).

A second independent TU-boundary signal from sbss/bss reference ownership (S32K UKDL candidate c), pre-registered with a positive control on real TU boundaries (not consecutive objects), before any arm field is read. Diagnostic only; no certificate.

Repair the S32K TU-boundary calibration: the control set must be real TU boundaries (S32K recall 0.613 on consecutive-object pairs; AMD-1 n=0 because carved single-fn objects sit between auto_03 pairs). Build the calibration set from boundaries that are independently known, demonstrate its size at freeze, keep the 0.80 bar.

The broad compiler swap matched 0.38 pct of CNM (negative row; reopen if a fingerprint-chosen subset predicts >= 5 pct). S26F W3 found a size<=32 selector with 7.4x held-out enrichment: pre-register that subset prediction on a fresh frozen cohort. Diagnostic unless a new additive profile meets all six S26C conditions.

KSR.reopen: a type source that beats the shuffled-type control by >= 5pp with 0 certified regressions
KSR.what: Global type context from lifted signatures (S30T REFUTED: gain came from having prototypes, not true types; 33 certified regressions).

TENNIS.what: B1-T: deterministic float-evidence scan of the Tennis COMPILES_NO_MATCH set; held-out fwidth pilot under the existing Tennis profile only if applicability >= 10 pct.

S31T proposal: draw the planted-positive controls from certified Tennis fns of ANY lane whose base_body holds a plantable f32, compiled at that lane's own flags, requiring planted != exact and unplanted == exact at that same arm; demonstrate the frozen pool is >= 22 at freeze time; keep the 22/22, 0/22 and 2 pct thresholds unchanged; then re-run B1-T (H-T1a) unchanged.
